description.value: Westview Bakery is North Vancouver's original French artisan bakery, operating since 1971 and producing slow-fermented sourdough breads, artisan loaves, pastries, sandwiches, and custom cakes from a retail storefront on Westview Drive. The bakery uses preservative-free, unbleached-flour recipes with traditional 48-hour sourdough fermentation across a wide range of flavour profiles. Touring cyclists can resupply with fresh bread, buns, and ready-made sandwiches, and the shop also offers online ordering and kids baking classes.
